title: Dhahran Hospital
hero.text: Specialised rehabilitation and long-term care, delivered through structured clinical pathways and multidisciplinary expertise.

text: At Cambridge Hospital Dhahran, we provide a supportive care environment that combines advanced medical technology, clinical expertise and dedicated rehabilitation facilities with a comfortable and welcoming setting. Our multidisciplinary team delivers compassionate, personalised care, working closely with patients and their families throughout their stay.

We focus on helping patients regain function, build confidence and achieve greater independence as they progress through their recovery. Each care plan is tailored to the patient’s needs and goals, with medical care, nursing support and rehabilitation working together to support progress and prepare patients for a safe return home or transition to the next stage of care.
